notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
Dowsing Shaman does not have summoning sickness.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Second Chance and take an extra turn.
Pay {2}{G} and tap Dowsing Shaman to return Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
